Boat capsizes off Cyprus, at least seven dead

A boat carrying migrants capsized off the coast of northern Cyprus, resulting in at least seven confirmed deaths. An additional 23 people are reported missing. Survivors were brought ashore. The exact number of individuals on board and the circumstances leading to the capsizing were not immediately detailed in the coverage.
